forms:
This issue’s feature article is all about Vespiquen!
What is the Beehive Pokémon’s surprising reaction
when given honey? Read on to find out!

“I just got this weird feeling when I was out in the
garden. Parasect was acting restless too, so I asked
it to dig here.”

With that, Caroline smiled and showed us a
mysterious fossil.

Minccino, Pikachu, and Other Pokémon with
Distinctive Tail-Based Greetings

In today’s world, so much about Pokémon ecology
has been explained through research. This time,
we’ve collected a special set of articles focused on
Pokémon greetings!

Undercuts and half updos are yesterday’s news! This
year’s hottest trend is the center part!

A hugely famous influencer recently posted a selfie
with a new parted hairstyle, and fans are going wild!
Young people everywhere are adopting this hairstyle
in droves!

Gym Leader Spotlight: Misty!

Misty, Gym Leader of the Cerulean City Gym, always
has a packed schedule, but she kindly gave us a full
day of her time for a comprehensive interview!

August’s special edition of Gym Leader Monthly will
be all about Misty, the tomboyish mermaid! Don’t miss
the stunning photo shoot—it’s sure to make a splash!

The Pokémon Fan Club is currently seeking
new members.

If you’re interested in joining, please visit the office!

Gym Leader Spotlight: Lieutenant Surge!

Lt. Surge, Gym Leader of the Vermilion City Gym,
may look intimidating, but you might be surprised
by the gentler side he shows when he’s with his
beloved Pokémon.

December’s special edition of Gym Leader Monthly
will focus on Lt. Surge, the Lightning Lieutenant!
You’ll see him in a whole new light!

The online Pokémon Contest on the fourth of this
month was won by none other than Isabelle and
Vulcan the Ninetales of the Vermilion City Pokémon
Fan Club!

Vulcan received 15,000 likes that day, beating the
second-place winner by a wide margin.

Recently, there have been many reports of people
going missing after walking alone at night. We spoke
with a person we’ll call “M,” who managed to escape
in the nick of time.

“Someone was waving their hand at me from down
the street. I ran away immediately, and I think that’s
what saved me,” said M.

Several survivors have speculated that these
disappearances may be the work of a ghost Pokémon.

You may notice that the S.S. Anne is a bit different
this year! The cruise route has been updated to bring
new experiences to our customers.

Wouldn’t you like to take a leisurely tour around the
world on a luxury cruise ship?

For more information, please call the following...

We’re back again with even more info about dream
jobs working with Pokémon! This month, we talked
with some of the nice ladies who spend their time
talking with Trainers and patching up Pokémon at
Pokémon Centers!

Where do they find joy in their jobs? What challenges
do they face? What are their favorite Pokémon? Read
on to find out all that and more!

Notice from the Celadon Game Corner:

We’ve recently received reports of suspicious-looking
characters spotted around our facility, and some
customers have expressed that they feel frightened
or unsafe playing here.

Our customers’ peace of mind is of the utmost
importance to us, so we’ve increased security patrols
on the premises.

The Poké Ball variation we’d like to showcase this
week is none other than the Love Ball!

This odd ball makes it easier to catch Pokémon when
yours is the opposite gender! What’s not to love?

Did you all know about this ball?

The city is still buzzing with talk of last month’s 17th
annual Pokémon Music Festival! The plaza in front of
the station was filled with performances by people
and Pokémon alike. Attendees at this year’s festival
enjoyed listening to all manner of music played by
a plethora of different Pokémon.

Tori’s spectacular performance was a huge highlight,
and the impassioned Kricketune concerto invited
countless standing ovations and calls for an encore.

Now let’s go over some of this week’s viral videos!
This week’s number-one spot goes to...
Toxel’s Tiny Tantrum!

Toxel takes a bite out of a berry behind its Trainer’s
back...only to find it does NOT like the taste one bit!
We can’t get enough of this Toxel tearfully thrashing
about with its tiny arms and legs, and we’re not alone!
Toxel’s adorable tantrum has garnered five million
views in just a week, clearly resonating with people
all around the world!

It has a round belly and loves to eat!
The fur on its body hides food underneath!
Whatever the meal, big or small—
in a single bite, it swallows it all!

Who’s that Pokémon?

Osu! The Fighting Fists and Feet is a new karate
dojo now open for business!

Beginners welcome to join!
Pokémon welcome to attend!
Everyone who signs up this month will receive a
free karate gi as part of our welcome giveaway!
Punch like Hitmonchan!
Kick like Hitmonlee!

To join, just call the number below and...

Abstract

Pidgeot possess high visual acuity. This study focused
on comparing the eyes of Pidgeot to other Pokémon,
and as a result, it successfully identified a specific
DNA strand that impacts eyesight. This DNA strand
demands further research, specifically with
applications in mind for restoring sight to humans.

Celadon University Research Team

Alola!
A new up-and-coming challenger has been attracting
a lot of attention at the Battle Royal Dome on
Royal Avenue!

The challenger’s name is Gladion. Within a single
day of his arrival, he and his Type: Null won a
Master Rank match!

Is there anyone out there who can defeat him?
Keep your eyes on the Battle Royal Dome to find out!

Alola!
How many of Alola’s tourist attractions do you think
you can name?

In our next issue, we’ll provide a comprehensive
introduction to Alola, including not only the most
popular hot spots but also some hidden gems!

Alola!
Acerola, captain of Ula’ula Island, has been selected
as an Elite Four member for the newly established
Alola Pokémon League!

It seems that Kahuna Nanu was initially nominated for
this position, but he turned the job down.

Leather jackets like those once worn by the “bad”
kids in town are making a fashion comeback!

“They’re so spiky and cool!”
“They give my cute outfits an edge!”
These are just a couple of the comments we’ve heard
about the jackets, which are popular among a variety
of different demographics, from rebellious teenagers
to fashionable, cosmopolitan women.

Gym Leader Spotlight: Bede!

Bede, Gym Leader of Ballonlea Stadium, has been
busy ever since he inherited the role from Opal,
the wizard. What’s he been up to, you ask?

Get a peek behind the scenes of a day in the life
of the pink-clad, Fairy-type-using Bede in June’s
ultra-elite edition of Gym Leader Monthly!

Bird Pokémon are cute!
Bird Pokémon are cool!
Bird Pokémon are THE BEST!

Fifty years ago, the first issue of Bird Pokémon
Monthly was published in the hopes of sharing these
feelings of admiration and appreciation of bird
Pokémon with people everywhere. We are honored to
celebrate the golden anniversary of this publication,
and we’re dedicated to extolling the virtues of these
majestic creatures for many more years to come!

This summer, Professor Oak’s Pokémon Talk will be
airing specially every morning starting at 8 a.m.!

Children can call in to have their questions answered
on air by Professor Oak himself! Please feel free to
call in with any questions you have about Pokémon!
The number to call is...

This special edition of Angler Monthly covers last
month’s Magikarp Fishing World Championship!

The winning Magikarp, caught by a woman from
Johto, measured a whopping 51.18 inches long!

Winner’s Comment:
I’ve been an avid fisher ever since I was a kid!
Over the years, I’ve caught a lot of Magikarp,
but this one is definitely the biggest by far!

New Bark Town is actively seeking new residents!

Our town boasts the twin attractions of abundant
nature and excellent educational facilities! In fact, a
former League Champion came from New Bark Town,
where he studied at Professor Elm’s lab and grew up
healthy and happy amidst the nearby greenery.

Come to New Bark Town for a relaxing life in the
perfect environment for raising children! If interested,
please visit the following site...

We are thrilled to announce that the Magnet Train
anniversary ceremony on the 8th of next month will
include a special appearance by the current Kanto
League Champion!

Three lucky children will be selected by lottery to
have a special exhibition battle with the Champion.
We look forward to your enthusiastic participation!

After decades of requesting interviews with a certain
legendary Trainer and former Champion of the Kanto
region, we finally managed get an exclusive meeting!

The photo he wordlessly showed us was a familiar and
memorable sight: himself as a smiling young boy,
surrounded by his Pokémon.

(To the editing department: FYI, this reporter is
personally a huge fan of the former Champion and
could not stop crying after the interview.)

Gym Leader Spotlight: Blue!

Blue’s accomplishments are many, and you can’t even
begin to talk about the Viridian City Gym without
mentioning his name! This edition of Gym Leader
Monthly looks at how he managed to change a former
Team Rocket hideout into a wildly popular Gym.

Find out all you’ve ever wanted to know about
Kanto’s former Pokémon League Champion!
Who could he have possibly considered a rival?!

The Sevii Islands, located in the southern part of the
Kanto region, are a popular vacation spot due to
their temperate climate.

We interviewed a girl visiting from Pallet Town who
had the following to say with a big smile on her face.
“I heard that there are a lot of rare Pokémon to see
here, so I’m really excited!”

The Rage Candy Bars of Mahogany Town are
attracting worldwide attention!

The trend started when a certain influencer went viral
with the phrase “Rage Candy Bars are terrifying!”
Seeing an opportunity to refresh the supposedly
old-fashioned treat’s image, a shop manager hired a
famous Johto region Trainer to film a commercial.
This commercial is now hugely popular among young
people, and Rage Candy Bars are flying off the
shelves faster than a fleeing Pidgey.

For our subscribers only!
Twenty lucky lottery winners will win two tickets each
to the Johto region!

The main stop on this trip will be the famous
Day Care on Route 34! We’ll chat with the couple
that works there about everything from their
work-life balance—how do they handle both their jobs
and their family life with their beloved grandchild?—
to their philosophy as Day Care staff!

Wanted: Information on a Red-Haired Boy

A highly important Pokémon was recently stolen from
New Bark Town’s Elm Pokémon Lab. Authorities are
looking for any information on a red-haired boy in his
early teens.

Witnesses claim that the boy, wearing dark clothing,
broke into the lab through a window and fled with
the Pokémon. Anyone with information on this young
boy is urged to contact Elm Pokémon Lab.

Kerry’s Ruin Exploration Column
Today, I’ll be exploring the Ruins of Alph in the
Johto region!

These ruins are said to be over 1,500 years old!
The writing on the walls inside have long since been
deciphered, but I still can’t help but feel a sense of
awe before this magnificent ancient structure.
I ran into another lady traveling alone while exploring
the ruins—she said she was on a journey to visit all
the Gyms of Johto! I wish her the best of luck!

Gym Leader Spotlight: Brock!

Brock, Gym Leader of the Pewter City Gym, has built
up a rock-hard defense using his well-trained muscles
and Pokémon—but what’s behind that hard exterior?

July’s special edition of Gym Leader Monthly will be
all about the rock-solid Pokémon Trainer Brock! Just
what is the secret to his stoicism?!

Are you ACTUALLY sleeping well?
Good sleep can help you stay healthy and energetic!
This issue will focus on tips to improve sleep.
Table of Contents
Page 04 – Sleeping Like Snorlax
- Sleeping position: Is stretching out the way to go?
- Poké Flute? Music? Finding the best alarm for you!
Page 12 – The Secret of Mareep-Wool Pillows
Page 16 – Delightful Vulpix-Shaped Bed Warmer
Page 20 – Leafeon Aroma for Relaxation
Page 24 – Jigglypuff’s Song—Ultimate Insomnia Cure?

We all know that everyone’s beloved music streaming
services are being forced to shut down one by one
due to the steep rise of server fees all over the world.

While music lovers are still mourning the loss of these
streaming services, it isn’t all bad news in the world
of music! It’s our pleasure to share a little about a
technological blast from the past—compact discs (CDs)!
The answer is...Munchlax!

CDs are cool little gadgets used by our great-great-
grandparents to listen to all their favorite music.
Each CD can hold a little over 10 songs, making it
easy to find a new favorite and listen to it over and
over again!

And that’s not all!

Each CD is a one-time purchase, which means that
there’s no need for a subscription fee—no matter how
many times you listen!

Poké Mart is working hard to create a solid lineup of
CDs for music lovers to choose from. We hope to be
THE destination for all those who want music in their
life—now and forever!

The story of Trace, former Champion of the
Kanto Pokémon League, and his faithful Marowak
companion is now available as a picture book!

His fateful encounter at Pokémon Tower,
the adventures that led him to become Champion—
it’s all available as a charming tale that is perfect to
read along with your children!

We sat down for an exclusive interview with Lorelei
of the Kanto Pokémon League’s Elite Four!

What does this Four Island native do on her days off?
Why does she love Ice-type Pokémon?
We uncover a cute side to the cool and beautiful
ice queen!

Cerulean City Gym Leader Misty has revealed her
morning routine in a video uploaded to her personal
social media accounts.
The morning training session with her Water-type
Pokémon sparked a variety of responses. Some called
it “just plain old hard training” or “impossible,” while
others voiced their desire to adopt the Tomboyish
Mermaid’s routine themselves.

The wildly popular video amassed over one
million views.

We’re happy to announce a special training plan for
the third anniversary of our fitness club, crafted
especially for the occasion as a way of saying thanks
to our community!

Course Details:
Swim! Row! Run! Revolutionize your style with this
exercise trifecta! And with Gallade’s psychic
support, anyone can join in at the resistance level
that suits them best—from beginners to training pros!
Don’t miss this chance! Join today!

A contest in Amity Square was held on the 20th of
last month with one objective: to see who was best
at zoning out. A Snorlax won by a landslide!
It put on a magnificent performance that lasted for
three whole days. Even the judges gave up watching
before it was over.
Later, it was discovered that Snorlax was not, in fact,
a registered participant! It was simply a wild Snorlax
enjoying one of its favorite spots.
The judges say they didn’t realize because they, too,
were happily zoning out.

Let’s go over some of this week’s viral videos!
This week’s number-one spot goes to...
“Rare Sighting: World’s Most Intense Splash!”

The video shows Gyarados using Splash over and
over...and nothing happens?! Or so we would think,
until we notice the huge crater forming beneath it!
A Splash specialist commented on the video:
“That was not Splash. It was most likely Bounce. The
Gyarados probably worked hard and learned the new
move after evolving.”

The Dowsing Machine has evolved in numerous
ways over its many years of use.
In this article, we’ll share a brief history of the
machine, paired with some comments from Trainers
who have long enjoyed using it.

“I used to wander around the Underground Path all
day with a Dowsing Machine in hand!”
(Female Trainer from Kanto)

The Mirage Cave. No one knows when or where it
will appear... What once was a place shrouded in
mystery has become an easily accessible sightseeing
spot thanks to the “Daily Mirage Location Report”
put out every morning on social media.

On his 50th visit to the Mirage Cave, one man had
this to say, with a hint of nostalgia in his voice:
“I used to have to soar in the sky every day looking
for this cave! What a convenient world we live in
these days, huh.”

Sweet? Spicy? How about sour? Pokéblocks, the
beloved treat from Hoenn, will be available in all
kinds of flavors in the exhibition hall. You’ll have no
trouble finding one your Pokémon enjoys!

Like last year, we will also be hosting a special
workshop with a Trainer from Hoenn to give
participants tips for making their own Pokéblocks!

No entry fee! Café booth on-site!
All photos are from last year’s event.

Lilycove Department Store’s Pokémon Lottery has
finally, finally found a grand prize winner!

The winner was overjoyed to receive their Master Ball
prize and said the following with a big smile:
“I have a Pokémon in mind that I really want to catch,
so this is amazing!”

Witness the Excitement In Person!
Let Your Cheers Fuel the Battles!

Get ready, because it’s nearly time for the Champion
Cup next month in Wyndon! The Pokémon League is
getting more and more exciting every year. Don’t miss
your chance to witness the action at Wyndon Stadium!

Arbok is known for using the frightening pattern on
its belly to scare its opponents, while Mawile lulls
foes into letting down their guard before chomping
them with its gaping jaws...

Given their variety of habitat and physical
appearance, it is only natural that Pokémon also have
a variety of ways to intimidate their opponents.
This special edition will take a closer look at the wide
world of Pokémon intimidation techniques!

Monthly Cerulean City Pokémon Race Report

This month’s race was all Corphish! Trainers from all
over brought their best Corphish to participate, and
the sight of them lined up ready to race was quite the
spectacle!

But perhaps the Pokémon were nervous? Or just
extremely excited? Either way, this month had a
whopping seven false starts in total, delaying the
start of the race by 10 whole minutes!

A new clock tower has been erected in the Cerulean
City town square, and a commemoration ceremony
was held on the 13th of this month.

The ceremony drew a large crowd, and attendees
were captivated by the sound of the bell ringing from
inside the tower.

This large and beautiful clock tower will undoubtedly
become a new symbol for the city of water, loved
by residents and visitors alike for years to come.

What is your honest opinion on the rumored move of
all of humanity to outer space? (Free answer)

- Kind of excited. Kind of scared.
- It’s gotta be a hoax.
- I can take my Pokémon with me, right?
- Starting to think this might not be fake.
- Can we ride robots?
- We’d better watch out for space viruses.
- Humanity still has the drive to take on new frontiers!
